pr.title: R0004: qualify resolved-day boot and legacy offline cache
pr.body:
Implements #4.

R0004 requires the first accepted current timetable to use the resolved location's civil date while preserving the selected legacy cache. The accepted loader/cache implementation is unchanged. This PR completes the required README/ARCHITECTURE clauses and adds source-bound native acceptance evidence using the delivered R0007/R0002 fixture and Playwright tools. The only shared driver change blocks external native requests in explicitly offline cases; normal cases and preservation inputs do not enter it.

Merge, GitHub Pages delivery, `CLOSE-R0004` publication and completed issue closure remain reserved for the owner's exact-head decision. This is a Draft PR and does not auto-close the issue.

All production runtime files equal delivered R0002/R0007. The evidence-only descendant retains the exact reviewed source. Initial acquisitions bind `40b12e3949c155c9baf3c2449f33b8d537128bc7`; the later offline-only increment is explicitly reconciled. Per-file inputs, observed HTML, browser binaries, raw traces and original videos are hash-bound.

## Original acceptance matrix

| Original obligation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 4.01–4.12 | Accepted historical owner-source proof retained after currentness; 119 fresh affected source tests pass with zero failures, skips or TODOs. Original loader/adoption/cache regions remain unchanged. |
| 4.13 / A01 | README and ARCHITECTURE now explain timezone hints, metadata-before-filter, resolved civil dates, `_cacheTz`, selected-key compatibility, one bounded correction, adoption/rollover/ownership, retry and dirty-frame presentation. Existing R0007/R0002 clauses remain. |
| 4.14 / A02 | Tokyo at `2026-09-07T22:00:00Z`, omitted URL timezone, browser New York: loading and zone-known states remain unavailable. The first accepted current timetable is September 8/Tokyo in both engines. Exactly one September 8 correction shares the bootstrap operation; September 9 prefetch is separately owned. |
| 4.14 / A03 | Strict offline selected-key matching, wrong-day, zone-free-only and both-key controls pass. Matching September 8 paints current; wrong-day metadata can resolve Tokyo without painting false current. Native external requests fail, and selected/unselected stored bytes remain exact. |
| 4.14 / A04 | Explicit-zone and shared-date positives, corrupt JSON/timings/zone/envelope cache and ingress negatives, and both original mutants pass their source-bound expectations. Mutants discriminate lost availability; the independent adoption safeguard still prevents false-current data. |
| 4.14 / A05 | A held September 8 correction released after Tokyo midnight stays unavailable; native cooldown recovery paints September 9. Actual settings change to New York B prevents late A from altering timetable, zone, generation or cache. |
| 4.14 / A06 | Required 325×530 card/row/footer/arc and root/offline/iframe states reviewed. Eight accepted preservation controls retain exact relevant runtime, input, observer, browser and original mode equality. Frozen V1 passes. |
| 4.15 / A07 | Exact source, all original requirements, 46 selected native acquisitions and retained contrary evidence independently accepted. Final artifact-head readback is recorded below. |
| 4.15 / A08 | Reserved: exact-head owner approval, merge, served runtime and README/ARCHITECTURE readback, actual public consumer, `CLOSE-R0004` publication/independent readback, then manual completed issue closure/final readback. |

The [complete packet and original matrix](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/README.md), [case index](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/cases.json), and [independent review](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/qualification/independent-review/independent-review.md) contain the underlying evidence and limitations.

## Actual native evidence

Playwright 1.60.0; Chromium 148.0.7778.96 and Firefox 150.0.2; Windows AMD64; viewport 370×570, DPR 1. Selected Firefox runs use the existing runner's default headless mode and video recorder. Native timers and animation remain unchanged.

- Omitted-zone first current: Chromium frame 85 / 3.36s ([original video](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/browser/chromium/R0004-omitted-zone22/native.webm)); Firefox frame 78 / 3.08s ([original video](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/browser/firefox/R0004-omitted-zone22/native.webm)). Both show all six controlled clocks and September 8. Every earlier native clock class and original render ordinal was reviewed.
- Offline matching cache: Chromium frame 16 / 0.60s ([video](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/browser/chromium/R0004-cache-current/native.webm)); Firefox frame 27 / 1.04s ([video](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000/docs/rlgwo-execution/20261014/R0004/browser/firefox/R0004-cache-current/native.webm)). Wrong-day and zone-free streams remain unavailable; full request ownership and storage receipts accompany every case.
- The selected 46 original acquisitions contain 9,388 indexed native frames. First-frame associations and all inspected clock strips are retained. Video PTS and fixture elapsed time have different origins; the review does not invent a unique video-frame-to-DOM-ordinal mapping.

Sixteen blank headed Firefox captures, including the exact R0002-environment retry, are excluded and retained. Twelve provider-only offline originals are superseded by strict external-network-offline recordings and retained. One superseded earliest Firefox mutant-positive frame has an incomplete Dhuhr row; its later healthy frame is not substituted. Fourteen trace-verifier negative controls reject weakened or falsified semantic evidence.

Selected Firefox videos retain intermittent blank/partial frames and 28 selected traces retain their raw partial-checkpoint status. Acceptance is bounded to the original first-current/unavailable and required-state predicates; this PR claims no new uninterrupted capture, headless motion, Moon or whole-scene startup qualification. The separate accepted preservation controls retain their original inputs and headed/headless modes. Local static documents/assets remain available in offline fixtures; all external native requests and controlled provider requests fail. No production defect is claimed or repaired.

## Independent final-head readback

The independent read-only reviewer accepted exact head `36a928f24c98ce4dbd6b5a3d609afd15546d7000`, tree `ca6b1dc78669c7bc7ec509fffb6b9138375a8a43`. All 1,264 manifested files, 386 independent-review projections, 74 original video/input/trace sets, 277 other relative references and all 135 runtime hashes were verified. No unresolved blocker remains. A01–A07 are qualified; A08 remains pending owner authorization and delivery/closure. Public PR/head readback follows publication; neither review grants merge authority.
